name: Ziz Fizziks
summary: On the western ridge of Windshear Crag, Ziz Fizziks has left the Venture Company for the Tinkers' Union. A gnome engineer's arrival drove him away, though his new superior works him just as hard.

sections.title: A Matter of Professional Pride
sections.body: The Venture Company brought Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, a gnome engineer, into its employ, and Ziz Fizziks took it as an insult. He could not bear working beside a gnomish rival, so he looked for a way out. Ziz contacted Sputtervalve, who represented the Tinkers' Union, and begged for a transfer away from Gerenzo's oversight.

sections.title: Out of the Frying Pan
sections.body: The Tinkers' Union gave Ziz Fizziks a new position, but not the easy life he expected. On the western edge of Windshear Crag, he found that Sputtervalve drove him as hard as any Venture Company foreman. Still, Ziz would rather labor under a demanding goblin superior than share an engineering workshop with a gnome.

faq.answer: Ziz Fizziks is a goblin engineer who once worked for the Venture Company in Stonetalon Mountains. He left after the company hired a gnomish engineer and joined the Tinkers' Union.

faq.q: Why did Ziz Fizziks leave the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Venture Company hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, a gnome engineer, and Ziz Fizziks refused to work beside him. Ziz begged Sputtervalve for a new position.

faq.q: Where can Ziz Fizziks be found?
faq.answer: Ziz Fizziks works along the western edge of Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. From there, he overlooks the Venture Company logging and excavation operations.
Sputtervalve is a goblin operative with the Tinkers' Union. He recruits skilled engineers from the Venture Company to work on competing projects.
Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle is a gnome engineer hired by the Venture Company to work at Windshear Crag. His arrival outraged Ziz and sparked a fierce professional rivalry.
The Tinkers' Union is an established goblin engineering trade association. It competes with the Venture Company and recruits or reclaims top talent.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see the fierce feud between Ziz and Gerenzo in the long-running, volatile rivalry between goblin and gnomish engineering philosophies.
As a Horde adventurer in Stonetalon Mountains, you may help Tinkers' Union operatives like Sputtervalve and Ziz disrupt the Venture Company's hold on Windshear Crag.
